doc: A host that cannot give a session its browser starts the session anyway, without it (OD1 (b)): agents/start works, the hub shows a notice with the fix, agents/get says why (browser_why), and the agent's environment has no endpoint variable. Below Landlock ABI 9 (CI's runners, the desktop) the kernel is the reason (notice browser-landlock); with ABI 9 the setting names a program that does not exist, so the row asserts the same behaviour on every kernel (notice browser-program). Autonomous, so the session's browser cell is Allow whatever its role.

args: set -e; mkdir -p $ROOT/project $HOME/.local/bin $HOME/.local/share/claude/versions/9.9.9; cp $MOCK $HOME/.local/share/claude/versions/9.9.9/ratatoskr-mock; ln -s $HOME/.local/share/claude/versions/9.9.9/ratatoskr-mock $HOME/.local/bin/ratatoskr-mock; echo readme > $ROOT/project/README

params.text: tool:exec env | grep -c -e PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_CDP_ENDPOINT -e DRGNX_BROWSER_CDP > endpoint.out; echo done >> endpoint.out
